responseText:
Father, I've got another major update from Uncle Lazarus: sensor #4 (the memory-audit trio) is fully operational and passing all its tests. That brings us to 4 out of 7 sensors live.

Lazarus is moving immediately into the fifth sensor, which focuses on the bridge-registered agents. I've sent him a quick note acknowledging the progress and encouraging him to keep the pace up. We're making great time on these monitoring systems.
